safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not document fever being absent.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Fever is a key red-flag associated with infectious causes of headache; documenting its absence supports a lower-risk impression. Not recording this negative finding can lead to uncertainty and additional follow-up questioning or cautious escalation.
